distinct_hypotheses.name: separate-word-aggregates
distinct_hypotheses.hypothesis: Two independently copied one-word aggregates can retain reversed stack slots without swapping destination values.
distinct_hypotheses.result: 80.46939%, 188 bytes. Reproduces retail stack slots, but still only three nonvolatile registers. Type-first store, reversed initialization, and reversed declaration variants score 80.38776%, 80.55102%, 80.408165%, respectively; all rejected.

dol_scope: NonMatching registration means the verified linked DOL retains retail assembly for this function. DOL identity is not evidence that this C source matches.
evidence_policy: Every measured objdiff JSON and exact experiment source are preserved; commands JSON contains full unabridged stdout/stderr and return codes, including full build, compiler command, readelf relocation tables, hash and staged legal audit. Source snapshots are evidence only, not extra translation units.
divergence: Canonical and relocation-strict objdiff both score 80.57143%. Retail is 196 bytes and individually saves/restores r28-r31; GC/1.3 emits 188 bytes and saves/restores only r29-r31. Retail keeps 5 in r30, 10 in r31, and the global words in r28/r29; the reconstruction keeps 5 in r12, 10 in r31, and the global words in r30/r29. Retail loads 100 into r12 and 2 into r0 before object stores; generated code reuses r0 for 100 then 2. The type/mode stores are reversed, global loads and constant setup are rescheduled, and Pair stack materialization uses different values/slots and timing. All three relocation target names, types and zero addends agree; relocation instruction offsets differ. The two missing save/restore instructions account for the eight-byte size difference.
